div.div:
LEGENDS
- blue = compute / model
(API + recommender)- red = cache (Redis recs store)
- green = SQL data
+ offline pipeline steps- orange = storage / model registry
- yellow = event log
- cyan = monitoring
- purple = LB / orchestrator
- solid arrow = request / data flow
- dashed = response / async
- ONLINE zone = 24/7
- OFFLINE zone = scheduled
